candidate_boundaries.retrieval_pool: Search the full compatible lightweight pool; retrieval pagination is not the Agent working set.
candidate_boundaries.fit_scoring_order: Native queries and prefetch use the same registered stage-fit evaluator over the complete eligible pool before selecting the bounded complete Agent working set. Do not rescore only the truncated page or add a second numerical ranking.
candidate_boundaries.active_choice_policy: Mechanical fit and effect consumers use every currently effective confirmed augment, deduplicated by canonical stage and identity. A bounded recent mixed-event history must not remove an active effect.
candidate_boundaries.display_set: Respect the user's requested number and the active strategic obligation's complete-candidate requirements.
candidate_boundaries.atomicity: Preserve complete roster, identity and required strategy facts for every materialized candidate. Shared evidence uses verifiable addresses rather than repeated full objects.
candidate_boundaries.task_boundary: Evidence presence cannot activate another mode's delivery contract. An explicitly absorbed strategic obligation retains its full contract even on a choice-confirmation turn.

purpose: Require every strategy answer owner to receive one immutable, policy-scoped, multi-route evidence plan and a machine-checkable coverage receipt before the Host forms an answer.

coverage_contract.critical_missing_policy: The Host may answer unaffected parts, but it must not invent the affected claim. Mark the result partial or blocked only for the obligations that cannot be answered responsibly.
coverage_contract.forbidden_policy: A forbidden source remains forbidden in prefetch, tools, scoring, answer selection, and recovery turns.
coverage_contract.wire_truth: A satisfied receipt must resolve to a key present in strategy_evidence_prefetch.evidence or to a verified snapshot-bound same-turn tool. A prefetch-only provider must downgrade absent evidence before dispatch.

forbidden_runtime_behavior: replace route evaluators with one global score
treat tags as a new strength authority
persist a complete Host payload or tool result corpus

migration_policy.final_state: All strategy answer entrypoints use this evidence plan and coverage contract.
